usageNotes: Returns the directory index of the cluster-level firewall API, listing available child endpoints (e.g. rules, groups, options, refs). Use this as a discovery call to confirm which firewall sub-resources are accessible on the cluster before querying them individually. No parameters are required and no special privilege beyond cluster membership is needed.
tips: The returned array contains child resource names (e.g. 'rules', 'groups', 'options', 'refs') that map directly to sub-paths under /cluster/firewall/.
This endpoint is purely navigational — use child endpoints to read or modify actual firewall rules and settings.
Accessible with API tokens (allowtoken: true), making it safe to include in read-only monitoring or discovery scripts.
